aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Alexandra, your local outdoor power equipment specialist. Murray Wilson runs the shop, and we stock STIHL, Cub Cadet, Hansa Chippers, Masport, Lawnmaster and Honda Power Equipment. Whatever your property or garden needs, we've got the gear to help you get the job done.

Our fully equipped workshop handles sales, servicing and repairs for all major outdoor power brands. Order online and choose delivery or click and collect from our store. We're open Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm.

Come in and see us. We'll help you find the right machine and keep it running well.
